disease_label_per_paper: Acute myocarditis with normal wall motion detected with 2D speckle tracking echocardiography
presentation_summary: 26-year-old man with acute tonsillitis, fever, chest pain, no cardiovascular risk factors, and infarct-mimic ECG changes.
Admission vitals included blood pressure 133/74 mmHg, heart rate 73/min, temperature 38.4 C, respiratory rate 21/min, and oxygen saturation 98% on room air.
ECG showed sinus rhythm with biphasic T waves; high-sensitivity troponin I was reported above 37,000 ng/L.
Laboratory evidence included CK 1913 U/L, CK-MB 92 U/L, WBC 13.2 x10^9/L, neutrophils 63%, and CRP 14.1 mg/dL.
Echocardiography showed preserved LVEF without conventional regional wall motion abnormality, but speckle tracking showed decreased lateral/posterior strain.
